option_relations.rationale: Eosinophilic annular erythema is a type of eosinophilic dermatitis, and in this context, it is likely drug-induced and immune-related due to the immunotherapy.
Wells syndrome (eosinophilic cellulitis) is a form of eosinophilic dermatitis, and in this case, it is likely drug-induced and immune-related due to the immunotherapy.

Granuloma annulare is a distinct dermatological condition characterized by granulomatous inflammation, which is different from the eosinophilic inflammation seen in the biopsy and the drug-induced eosinophilic dermatitis leaf.

Drug-induced erythema annulare centrifugum is a type of drug-induced dermatitis, and given the eosinophilic findings, it could fall under the broader category of drug-induced eosinophilic dermatitis, immune-related.
